## Pre-flight Check

**Have you sung to Miku today?** (y/n)

> If your answer is "n", close this tab, sing one (1) song with
> conviction, then come back. We'll wait.

## Describe the bug

A clear and concise description of how Miku has failed you, or
more likely, how you have failed Miku.

## To Reproduce

Steps to reproduce the disappointment:
1. Run `init()`
2. ...
3. `worthy` evaluates to `false`
4. Weep

## Expected behavior

What you thought Miku would do, before you were humbled.

## Screenshots

If applicable, add screenshots of the exact moment things went
wrong. Miku will judge them personally.

## Environment (please complete the following information)

- OS: [e.g. Windows 900000]
- Storage available: [e.g. 10 Exabyte, or "not enough, shamefully"]
- Songs played per second: [e.g. 9000, or "an embarrassingly low number"]
- Soul status: [e.g. transferred / withheld / currently negotiating]

## Additional context

Add any other context about the problem here, including any
attempts at self-reflection.
